clips.title: The story
paras: Beneath the Thandol Span, Deepfury's Orders lie with the fallen Ol' Rustlocke. The crumpled parchment carries grim instructions from the Dark Iron dwarves who ambushed the scouting defender.

Ol' Rustlocke, a dwarven bridge defender, was scouting the foundations of the Thandol Span when Dark Iron dwarves cornered and slew him. Beside his clenched fist lay crumpled orders drafted by their leader, Deepfury. The parchment is direct proof of a coordinated plot against the bridge linking the Wetlands and the Arathi Highlands.
